subject: Daz
fact: Daz feels cognitive friction from a chant he recognizes as degraded, similar to patterns seen in Eldred and the Field Ward Preacher.
source_quote: I have seen it before. Twice. Eldred had it, earlier in the journey — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz attributes his sensation to sunlight, having been outside for an unusually long time.
source_quote: I had been attributing the sensation to sunlight. I had, in fact, been attributing it to sunlight for most of the day.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz writes down the exact cadence and false syncopation of the chant he recognizes.
source_quote: I wrote it down. The exact cadence, the placement of the false syncopation, the point in the verse where the chant bent away from the original.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz closes his journal after writing down the chant's pattern.
source_quote: Yeah, sure," I said, and closed my journal.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum offers the bard a silver piece for a song about Stroud's famous chess game.
source_quote: Grygum leaned forward — he has a scholar's interest in Stroud that he performs slightly harder than the interest actually requires — and offered her a silver piece for something about Stroud's famous chess game.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum identifies himself as Bahamutian with sentimentality for Stroud.
source_quote: he explained that he was Bahamutian, with sentimentality for the other.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalls a previous campaign involving giants and love that was not Stroud's.
source_quote: The only love I remember during the previous campaign," he said, "involved giants, and it wasn't Stroud's.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says "These things have to be done with a grain of salt."
source_quote: These things have to be done with a grain of salt.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is assigned to Vareth as his handler at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Grygum to Vareth.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum summarizes the presence of the miniaturized House T'sarran spy as "We've been caught."
source_quote: Grygum summarized, with admirable brevity, as: "We've been caught."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin spends the evening outside with Dawnbringer at the sea.
source_quote: Thorin spent the evening outside with Dawnbringer, standing at what I understand was his first real encounter with the sea.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin finds Dawnbringer's light defeating the purpose of viewing the sea to be peaceful.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, predictably, lit up everything around them, which defeated the purpose of going outside to look at the sea. Thorin apparently found this peaceful rather than counterproductive.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, "Life takes you in weird directions and weird places, you just gotta go with it."
source_quote: Life takes you in weird directions and weird places," he said. "You just gotta go with it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks Glabbagool whether it has thoughts on the spy's imprisonment.
source_quote: Thorin, who processes things by talking, asked whether Glabbagool had thoughts on the matter.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin observes that Glabbagool seems ambivalent about watching the spy.
source_quote: Thorin observed that Glabbagool seemed ambivalent.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks if Zalthir can attack the blind monk while he walks away.
source_quote: Thorin, from the side: "Can he attack him while he's walking away? Blindside him, as it were?"

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir climbs to the roof to meditate and returns with the expression of someone closing an internal argument.
source_quote: Zalthir climbed to the roof to meditate. He came back down later, settled. The expression of someone closing an internal argument, not opening an external one.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says "Hmm, true," in the tone of completing an internal argument.
source_quote: He said "Hmm, true," about something, in the tone of a man completing an internal argument rather than beginning an external one.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is assigned to Brother Khell-Vire as his handler at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Zalthir to Brother Khell-Vire.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is asked by Khell-Vire what he was sent toward, not why he was sent.
source_quote: What were you sent toward? Not why were you sent here?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir responds to Khell-Vire's question with "Granted, given that constraint or specification, can you clarify?"
source_quote: Granted, given that constraint or specification, can you clarify?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, "I've played this game before, my friends," addressing the tradition of shadow monk pedagogy.
source_quote: I've played this game before, my friends,

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is told by the blind monk that he skips the third breath and lets ki bleed into his fingertips like poison.
source_quote: You skip the third breath. You don't enter your ki in the hara. You let it bleed into your fingertips like a poison.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is told by the blind monk that he arrived three seconds faster than the Grandmaster despite technically wrong technique.
source_quote: And yet, you arrived at your destination three seconds faster than the Grandmaster did.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asks the blind monk if he can punch him.
source_quote: Zalthir asked whether he could punch the monk.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir fails the Weightless Shadow technique by rolling catastrophically and falling.
source_quote: He rolled catastrophically. He fell.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir fails the Efficient Strike technique, and the monk asks if he practiced forms while traveling.
source_quote: The corridor was narrow. The form was irrelevant. Did you not practice your forms while traveling?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir attempts the Eldritch Claw using stealth and rolls an insufficient number.
source_quote: Zalthir tried stealth for the Eldritch Claw. His number landed somewhere that would have been insufficient even with generous interpretation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir rolls a 30 to hit during the monk's departure, and asks if it gets him anything.
source_quote: I mean, I rolled a 30 to hit. Does that get me anything?

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool has been watching the spy and finds her entertaining.
source_quote: He'd been doing prison-watching, he explained, and was kind of bored. But the spy was not without entertainment value.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool says the spy keeps trying to kill him, and he slaps her around.
source_quote: She kept trying to kill him. He'd slap her around.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool says the spy screams when he tries to teach her meditation.
source_quote: She'd scream about the meditation.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool says he and the spy have become great friends.
source_quote: He said they'd become great friends.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool asks Zalthir if watching the spy makes him more or less of a monk.
source_quote: Zalthir? Will I be more of a monk or less of a monk by watching her? Is this some kind of pre-monk training you've put me in?

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool says he will keep an eye on the spy after Zalthir confirms it is training.
source_quote: I will keep an eye on her!

subject: Sister Yvenne
fact: Sister Yvenne is assigned as Daz's handler at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Daz to Sister Yvenne.

subject: Brother Khell-Vire
fact: Brother Khell-Vire is a two-hundred-year-old half-elven shadow monk who wears a faded shadow monk under-robe under Candlekeep gray.
source_quote: Two hundred years old, half-elven, eighty years gone from the Garden of Shadow after refusing an order he never explained. He wore a faded shadow monk under-robe beneath the Candlekeep gray

subject: Brother Khell-Vire
fact: Brother Khell-Vire has a note on his desk reading "Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings."
source_quote: On Khell-Vire's desk, visible from where I was standing: *Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.*

subject: Brother Khell-Vire
fact: Brother Khell-Vire tells Zalthir that he will not be present during the trial and that it is Zalthir's work.
source_quote: I will not be there. This is your work, not mine.

subject: Brother Khell-Vire
fact: Brother Khell-Vire asks Zalthir if the phrase "the Bone King sings" refers to an entity, event, or person.
source_quote: Is it an entity? An event? A person?

subject: Bookwyrm
fact: Bookwyrm is the First Reader at Candlekeep who assigns handlers without ceremony.
source_quote: Bookwyrm — the First Reader, a dragonborn sage — assigned us each to a handler without ceremony.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch is the Gate Warden who explains Candlekeep's policy on prisoners.
source_quote: They summoned someone called Kalan Strongbranch. Gate Warden.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch says Candlekeep holds prisoners but does not keep them.
source_quote: We hold prisoners. We do not keep them.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch says Candlekeep will not deliver the spy to House T'sarran or execute her.
source_quote: We will not deliver to House T'sarran, and we will not execute her.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch says Candlekeep will eventually release the spy with a warning.
source_quote: Eventually, we will release her at our gate with a warning.

subject: The spy
fact: The miniaturized House T'sarran spy is furious when told her fate is not hers to decide.
source_quote: The spy was furious. She turned to Kalan and announced that she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: The spy
fact: The spy announces she is a prisoner and wishes to be formally jailed by Candlekeep.
source_quote: she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: The spy
fact: The First Reader says the spy is a guest of Candlekeep and a member of the adventuring party.
source_quote: as a guest of Candlekeep — as a member, technically, of our adventuring party — the decision was ours, not hers.

subject: The spy
fact: The spy has opinions, several of them.
source_quote: The spy did not take this well. She had opinions. Several of them.

subject: Brother Ferrath
fact: Brother Ferrath taught a class on the difference between solutions and postponements.
source_quote: There was a class at the monastery — I think it was Brother Ferrath, or possibly Brother Aldas, I'm genuinely uncertain — on the difference between solutions and postponements.

subject: Brother Aldas
fact: Brother Aldas may have taught the class on solutions and postponements.
source_quote: There was a class at the monastery — I think it was Brother Ferrath, or possibly Brother Aldas, I'm genuinely uncertain — on the difference between solutions and postponements.

subject: Eldred
fact: Eldred exhibited the same degraded chant pattern as the young scholar, and later went insane.
source_quote: Eldred had it, earlier in the journey — the man who went insane.

subject: Field Ward Preacher
fact: The Field Ward Preacher exhibited the same degraded chant pattern as the young scholar.
source_quote: The Field Ward Preacher had it too.

subject: Vareth
fact: Vareth is assigned as Grygum's handler at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Grygum to Vareth.

subject: Master Archivist Philemon
fact: Master Archivist Philemon is assigned as Thorin's handler at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Thorin to Master Archivist Philemon.

subject: The Burning Wizard Inn
fact: The Burning Wizard Inn has a south wall with a soot mark that always sits in the same place.
source_quote: The soot mark on the south wall sat where it always sat.

subject: The Burning Wizard Inn
fact: The Burning Wizard Inn's floor is scrubbed every season.
source_quote: The floor, scrubbed every season.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep is a dark stack of towers against the sky, visible from miles out along the Way of the Lion.
source_quote: Candlekeep is visible from miles out — a dark stack of towers against the sky, impossible to mistake.

subject: Echoing Hall
fact: The Echoing Hall has stone corridors that return sound slightly altered, as if taking notes.
source_quote: Stone corridors in Candlekeep's north inner ward have a habit of returning sound to you slightly altered — not an echo exactly, more like the library itself was taking notes.

subject: lower-gallery office
fact: The lower-gallery office contains Shadow Discipline Lineage Records.
source_quote: the lower-gallery office, where the Shadow Discipline Lineage Records were kept

subject: bell tower
fact: The bell tower at Candlekeep has cells that are comfortable and locally anti-magic.
source_quote: The bell tower has cells. Comfortable, localized anti-magic.

subject: silver piece
fact: Grygum offers a silver piece to the bard for a song about Stroud's chess game.
source_quote: offered her a silver piece for something about Stroud's famous chess game.

subject: Sava game set
fact: The Sava game set is on a zurkhwood table in the guard chamber.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs, a smaller side table, and a Sava game set on the table

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a grey ooze carried in a bag with the miniaturized House T'sarran spy.
source_quote: we were carrying both a grey ooze and a miniaturized House T'sarran operative in the same bag

subject: miniaturized House T'sarran spy
fact: The miniaturized House T'sarran spy is carried in a bag with Glabbagool and was visible to Bookwyrm at the gate.
source_quote: the miniaturized House T'sarran spy had been right there alongside him, which she apparently found unacceptable

subject: journal
fact: Daz writes the chant's pattern in his journal and then closes it.
source_quote: I wrote it down... Yeah, sure," I said, and closed my journal.

subject: note
fact: The note on Khell-Vire's desk reads "Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings."
source_quote: *Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.*

subject: grey ooze
fact: Glabbagool is a grey ooze carried in a bag with the spy.
source_quote: we were carrying both a grey ooze and a miniaturized House T'sarran operative in the same bag

subject: House T'sarran spy
fact: The miniaturized House T'sarran spy is a sentient operative who tries to kill Glabbagool.
source_quote: the miniaturized House T'sarran spy... She kept trying to kill him.

subject: the chant pattern
fact: The degraded chant pattern matches those seen in Eldred and the Field Ward Preacher, both of whom experienced madness.
source_quote: I have seen it before. Twice. Eldred had it, earlier in the journey — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.

subject: the Bone King sings
fact: The phrase "the Bone King sings" appears on a note in Khell-Vire's office and is unknown to Zalthir and Khell-Vire.
source_quote: *Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.*

subject: the spread of madness
fact: The madness observed in the Underdark has continued to affect Daz after reaching the surface.
source_quote: Whatever was happening to Daz had started below ground and apparently had not stopped at the surface.

subject: Daz's cognitive friction
fact: Daz experiences cognitive friction from recognizing a degraded chant pattern.
source_quote: I had been attributing the sensation to sunlight... The same pattern. The same wrongness by a hair.

subject: Grygum's silver piece offer
fact: Grygum offers a silver piece to the bard for a song about Stroud's chess game.
source_quote: offered her a silver piece for something about Stroud's famous chess game.

subject: bard sings love song
fact: The bard sings a love song involving flowers and drinking after receiving the silver piece.
source_quote: She took the coin and proceeded to sing a love song. Involving flowers. And drinking.

subject: Zalthir climbs to the roof
fact: Zalthir climbs to the roof to meditate and returns settled.
source_quote: Zalthir climbed to the roof to meditate. He came back down later, settled.

subject: Thorin encounters the sea
fact: Thorin stands at the sea for the first time with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: Thorin spent the evening outside with Dawnbringer, standing at what I understand was his first real encounter with the sea.

subject: Candlekeep gate inspection
fact: The party opens their bag at Candlekeep's gate to show Glabbagool and the spy to the guards.
source_quote: when we'd come through the gate, we'd had to open it to show the guards Glabbagool, and the miniaturized House T'sarran spy had been right there alongside him

subject: Kalan Strongbranch's pronouncement
fact: Kalan Strongbranch declares Candlekeep will not execute or deliver the spy, but will eventually release her with a warning.
source_quote: We will not deliver to House T'sarran, and we will not execute her. Eventually, we will release her at our gate with a warning.

subject: spy demands imprisonment
fact: The spy announces she is a prisoner and wishes to be formally jailed by Candlekeep.
source_quote: she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: Glabbagool begins watching the spy
fact: Glabbagool accepts Zalthir's affirmation that watching the spy is monk training and vows to keep an eye on her.
source_quote: I will keep an eye on her!

subject: Zalthir's trial begins
fact: Zalthir is tested by a blind monk in the lower-gallery office.
source_quote: The blind monk entered without introduction and said: "Give me a standard shadow step."

subject: Zalthir shadow steps
fact: Zalthir performs a shadow step for the blind monk.
source_quote: Zalthir shadow stepped.

subject: Zalthir punches the monk
fact: Zalthir punches the blind monk during his trial.
source_quote: Zalthir asked whether he could punch the monk. He could. He did.

subject: Zalthir fails Weightless Shadow
fact: Zalthir rolls catastrophically and falls during the Weightless Shadow technique.
source_quote: He rolled catastrophically. He fell.

subject: Zalthir fails Efficient Strike
fact: Zalthir fails the Efficient Strike technique, and the monk questions his lack of practice while traveling.
source_quote: He tried the Efficient Strike. Athletics. Another catastrophe.

subject: Zalthir attempts Eldritch Claw with stealth
fact: Zalthir attempts the Eldritch Claw using stealth and rolls an insufficient number.
source_quote: Zalthir tried stealth for the Eldritch Claw. His number landed somewhere that would have been insufficient even with generous interpretation.

subject: Zalthir rolls 30 to hit during monk's departure
fact: Zalthir rolls a 30 to hit the monk as he walks away and asks if it gets him anything.
source_quote: I mean, I rolled a 30 to hit. Does that get me anything?

subject: the day Daz feels cognitive friction
fact: Daz has been outside in the sun for an unusually long time on the day he feels cognitive friction.
source_quote: It has been a while since I have been outside in the sun this long.
